newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gives Gerdau three options on Pains.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gives Gerdau three options on Pains.

text.p: Brazil's anti-trust body CADE has given the Gerdau steel group three options for undoing the monopolistic effects of its purchase two years ago of steel-rod maker Pains, an official said.

Cesar Mattos, a CADE aide, said the body voted three to two to give Gerdau the choice of reorganizing Pains to undo the negative market impact of the purchase, leasing its Contagem unit for 20 years or selling the firm.
"This proposal was approved as a way to implement last year's decision against the purchase," Mattos said.
CADE, which stands for the Administrative Economic Defense Council, valued Gerdau's purchase of Pains in 1994 at $45 million.
